sources.snippet: This is the repository where you can find ModernBERT, our experiments to bring BERT into modernity via both architecture changes and scaling. This repository noticeably introduces FlexBERT, our modular approach to encoder building blocks, and heavily relies on .yaml configuration files to build models.
